contamination: team inputs are season-to-date leaderboards, so every graded game is inside its own features; this measures calibration, not out-of-sample skill

vintage_coverage.note: 1 vintages, 0 missing days inside the span; a game is gradable when a vintage cutoff is strictly before it

note: no completed-game cache and/or no leaderboards; run betting_model.build_game_cache() on a box that has .cache/game_feeds

vintage.label: vintage (each game priced on leaderboards dated strictly before it)
vintage.note: no completed game has a leaderboard vintage dated strictly before it, so the honest sample is empty; run leaderboard_vintages.snapshot() nightly and this number starts climbing

gates.why: the contaminated forward margin over the home-field baseline is +0.005794 Brier with a paired sd of 0.08647, so a margin that size needs 603 games to clear one-sided 95%; 600 is that number, and a clean margin will be smaller, so this is a floor and not a pass

gates.need: paired Brier vs the home-field baseline, t >= 1.645
gates.why: sample size is not evidence; the model has to actually beat 'always take the home team' on games it could not see

gates.need: settled bets with a taken price, enough that some edge threshold clears an ROI lower bound of zero on at least 100 of them
gates.why: an edge threshold is a claim about EV against real prices; 0 dates of odds snapshots are cached and no settled-bet join exists yet

sweep.reason: no settled bets with both a model edge and a taken price; the threshold cannot be swept on data that does not exist

min_edge_gate.policy: min_edge stays null until all three gates are open. A threshold invented to make a pick appear is the single most dishonest number this module could publish.
